items.text: Saeed Laylaz stated that the country cannot be governed with hesitation and the government must make decisive decisions. He described economic reforms as necessary and painful and warned that increasing fuel prices without controlling liquidity growth could lead to social protests. He also said that confrontation with the US and maintaining the satisfaction of all social classes is impossible.

Mostafa Moeini Arani, the representative of Kashan, described unveiled and improperly veiled behavior as a serious social problem and called for its prevention. He urged officials not to let the sacrifices of martyrs be in vain. He also requested Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf to enforce the hijab and chastity law.

The New York Times reported that Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz continue after more than six months of war. The oil passage through the Strait is about 60% lower than before the war. US protective operations since late April have helped the passage of thousands of ships and millions of barrels of oil.

A citizen sent a video showing a group of government supporters waving flags at a nighttime gathering. He says the number of these people is small and they are government dependents. The video was published by Iran International.

An official in Israel's National Security Council stated that the Islamic Republic has increased efforts to target opponents, journalists, Jews, and Israelis abroad. Operational units are active in various countries and exploit the lack of full security support for opponents. The official also mentioned the Islamic Republic's revenge efforts following the killing of Ali Khamenei and senior officials.

Mehdi Moslehi described the gasoline crisis in Iran as a result of distribution and economic problems. He stated that the Islamic Republic cannot blame gasoline shortages on consumer usage. He also pointed to the lack of options for fuel-efficient vehicles and public transportation.

Saeed Shiayi, a 17-year-old teenager detained during the nationwide protests of December 2025, was released on bail from the Mashhad Correction and Rehabilitation Center. He is a resident of Sabzevar. The news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

A worker on the Ahvaz metro project set himself on fire in front of the city hall due to five months of unpaid wages and dismissal. He was rescued by other workers and taken to the hospital. This incident occurred on the morning of Sunday, September 6.

The father of Ilya Ojaqloo protested the destruction of his son's tombstone by removing the picture of his brothers killed in the Iran-Iraq war. Ilya Ojaqloo, 18 years old, was shot and killed on the evening of January 8, 2026, in front of Sabzeh Meydan police station in Zanjan.

Xabi Alonso and Mikel Arteta, childhood friends and rivals, now face each other as managers of Chelsea and Arsenal in the English Premier League. Both coaches grew up in San Sebastián and the Antiguoko club, a key center for developing football coaches. The culture of competition and the Basque people's passion for sports played an important role in shaping this generation of coaches.

Gol Gohar Sirjan club has protested the lack of a temporary order against Khodadad Azizi. The club stated it will pursue the insulting behaviors of Azizi during and after the match against Tractor through legal channels. They have the original audio file attributed to him and will submit it to the relevant authorities for investigation.

The head of the Welfare Organization announced the identification of 2,088 out-of-school children among those under the organization's coverage. Additionally, about four thousand child laborers in Tehran have been organized. These figures relate to the status of child laborers and out-of-school children.

The commander of North Khorasan's IRGC announced the revival and reconstruction of verbal reminder groups in the province. These groups aim to promote Islamic values, modesty, and hijab. Additionally, cultural billboards and advertising structures will be installed throughout the city.

CENTCOM announced that US forces have redirected 92 commercial ships and disabled three ships by September 5. They have boarded two ships to ensure compliance with the blockade. A stealth F-35 fighter also patrolled the waters during the blockade.
Ezzatollah Zarghami stated that due to Ahmad Jannati's advanced age, it is not possible to meet or talk with him. He added that no one dares to discuss Jannati's condition.

A 34-year-old protester in Qazvin was severely injured by live ammunition during the December protests. He has undergone five surgeries and is still receiving treatment. His family has pursued part of the treatment secretly and at great expense due to security concerns.

A citizen in a video to Iran International says they eat chicken feet for dinner due to severe price increases. He expressed dissatisfaction with the economic situation. The video reflects people's concerns about inflation.

Mehdi Chamran, head of Tehran City Council, stated that Iran should not allow attacks and must act preemptively. He emphasized that the Islamic Republic should respond to US actions with unity and resistance. He also expressed regret that such a person is the president of the United States.

Ali Manouchehrabadi, 21 years old, died in Tehran due to direct shooting by officers. His mother lit a candle in the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" in his memory. She said her son was the foundation that could have built his homeland.

The head of the Cinema House board reported an increase in summons and case formations for filmmakers after the recent war. Even sharing or liking certain images on social media has led to case formations. The Cinema House's protest was sent to Masoud Pezeshkian and referred to the head of the judiciary and the Culture and Media Prosecutor's Office for review.

Mostafa Moeini Arani, representative of Kashan, described the state of hijab as a deep wound on society. He requested the parliament speaker to notify the government president about the hijab and chastity law. Additionally, Mohammad Seraj mentioned the activity of malicious elements promoting immorality.

The Intelligence Organization of the IRGC in Fars province announced the arrest of eight individuals due to alleged connections with opposition groups and participation in the protests of January 2026. These individuals were arrested in Fars province. Further details have not been disclosed.

Armin Teymouri Rad, 19, his father Omid Teymouri Rad, 47, and his uncle Omid Teymouri Rad, 42, were killed on January 8 in Fardis, Karaj by government forces. The date on their grave is January 9. Omid's wife and Armin's mother were also severely injured by gunfire.

The price of the dollar in Iran's free market returned to the 226,000 toman range after surpassing 230,000 toman. The dollar rate on Sunday morning was 226,105 toman. Eghtesad News attributed this decline to the Central Bank's intervention in the market.

Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said on Sunday, September 6, a day after the US attack on several Iranian tankers in the Persian Gulf, that the era of 'proportionate responses' is over. He threatened that any aggression against Iran would receive a 'faster, heavier, and more painful' response. Ghalibaf also acknowledged economic problems including currency fluctuations, inflation, and unemployment.

The IRGC claimed to have targeted a US Central Command unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. The US military denied the claim, calling it a complete lie. The CENTCOM spokesperson refuted the statement.
The police commander of Aran and Bidgol announced that six commercial units in this county were sealed due to publishing content on social media that was against public decency and social norms.

Steve Whitkoff and Jared Kushner, special envoys of Donald Trump, visited Kyiv after meeting Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Volodymyr Zelensky emphasized the need for security guarantees to end the Russia-Ukraine war. These meetings are part of Washington's efforts to end the war.

Razieh Alishvandi stated that efforts to follow up on the status of four captured pilots in Qatar have not yet yielded results. A meeting is planned between the head of Iran's Red Crescent and the head of the International Committee of the Red Cross. A request for a meeting with the Qatar Red Crescent has also been submitted.

Asieh Amini states that children in deprived areas still study in containers with minimal educational facilities. She points to a large number of students dropping out of school due to poverty. Additionally, part of the education budget is spent on ideological programs and political objectives.

The director general of education in Fars announced a shortage of about four thousand personnel in the province's schools. He also mentioned a potential 3 to 5 percent shortage of classrooms in the upcoming school year. This situation is due to the transfer of some students from private to public schools because of families' economic difficulties.

The New York Times reported that oil passage through the Strait of Hormuz has decreased by about 60 percent compared to before the war. The Islamic Republic has targeted at least 23 ships in recent months. This situation has caused many shipping companies to avoid returning to the Persian Gulf.

Middle Eastern oil-exporting countries are expanding alternative routes to reduce oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz. Iraq transports over 100,000 barrels of oil daily by truck to Syria. The UAE plans to double its oil pipeline capacity to the Gulf of Oman, and Saudi Arabia exports most of its oil via the Red Sea.

Japan has stated that it has not yet decided on sending defense forces to the Strait of Hormuz. The country has not ruled out the option of deploying troops. This statement came alongside Donald Trump's request to US allies to participate in securing the Strait of Hormuz.

Nejat Bahrami, a political analyst, stated that retirees' slogans have shifted from labor demands to political slogans against government officials. He said that labor protests have failed to address livelihood demands. Some protesters believe their demands have gone beyond labor issues.

The brother of Mojtaba Khamenei's wife revealed that Ali Khamenei has handed over the political, security, and financial affairs of the country to his son for 25 years. Meanwhile, The Sunday Times reported that two luxury apartments of Mojtaba Khamenei in London, worth 36 million pounds, have been put up for sale. This report was prepared by Mojtaba Pourmohsen.

Amir Ali Falahati, a teenager from Mashhad who was detained during military clashes, was released on bail. This release took place on Saturday, 14 Shahrivar 1405. The news was reported by HRANA news agency.

The National Security Commission of the Parliament approved Article 9 of the Strategic Action Plan to Secure the Strait of Hormuz. According to this resolution, passage of vessels or cargo related to countries that sanction the Islamic Republic or take hostile actions is prohibited. The Armed Forces Headquarters is responsible for identifying hostile actions, and the Supreme National Security Council will determine the countries and institutions imposing sanctions.

The governor of Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad announced that 176 villages are facing water stress. The governor of Boyer-Ahmad reported severe water stress in 9 villages, with some springs completely dried up. The CEO of the water and wastewater company stated that restoring springs and water transmission lines is essential for sustainable water supply.

Chris Wright, the US Energy Secretary, said Iranians are still causing problems but the US Navy is winning the battle. Over 9 million barrels of oil pass daily through the Strait of Hormuz, with flow restored to two-thirds of pre-conflict levels. CENTCOM reported US forces have redirected 92 ships and disabled several vessels so far.

According to a report by the Joint Maritime Information Center, no oil tanker passed through the Strait of Hormuz without US assistance from 12 to 14 Shahrivar. During the same period, US data indicates 59 cases of ships passing with the country's help.

The Israeli Prime Minister stated that the country is stronger than ever and has eliminated the threat of nuclear bombs and ballistic missiles. He said the Iran axis has been targeted and the Iranian regime is collapsing. Netanyahu warned that if Iran attacks Israel, it will suffer a severe blow.

Tractor Club stated that the released audio file of Khodadad Azizi was edited and distorted, calling it against national and security interests. The club requested the competent authorities to investigate the matter. It also announced that judicial and disciplinary follow-up will be carried out.

Steve Whitcaff and Jared Kushner, special envoys of the US, met with Volodymyr Zelensky in Kyiv. The goal of the meeting was to end the war with a just peace and prevent further aggression against Ukraine. This trip is part of the Trump administration's efforts to advance peace negotiations.

The US dollar rate in Iran's free market reached 228,000 tomans. The price of each new design gold coin also increased to 239,500,000 tomans. Arzoo Karimi evaluated the price fluctuations and the role of the Central Bank.

Chris Wright, the US Secretary of Energy, said the United States is pressuring Iran's economy to change the current government's policy or form a new government. He described preventing Iran's oil and gas exports as the US military's main role in this strategy. Wright also emphasized that the US is always ready for an agreement and that Donald Trump's goal is to reach a negotiated solution.

Barcelona secured their fourth consecutive La Liga win by defeating Valencia 5-0. The team took sole possession of the top spot with 12 points. Lamin Yamal, Lopez, Rafinha, and Pedri scored the goals in this match.

Soheila (Elham) Alizadeh, a resident of Mahabad, was arrested by the intelligence agency officers. She was transferred to one of the detention centers of this agency in Urmia. This event occurred today.

Germany's Ministry of the Interior is planning a security shield to counter drone, cyber, and sabotage attacks on critical infrastructure. The German Interior Minister described combined Russian attacks as a daily reality expected to increase. This report was published by Ali Hassanpour from Iran International.

The US Central Command announced that the Iranian tanker Kaylo sank in the Gulf of Oman. CENTCOM attributed the incident to the precision and professionalism of US military forces. The tanker Kaylo has joined the Iranian navy in the depths of the sea.

Esteghlal and Aluminium football teams drew 0-0 in the sixth week of the Premier League. Both teams remained in second and third place with 12 points. Tractor is the league leader, and Persepolis will move to second place if they win tomorrow.
Some neighboring countries have refused to accept Iran's transit shipments. Iranian trucks remain stranded at the borders. Tehran cannot rely unconditionally on transit through Islamabad.

Ali Mohammad Baghshahi, a clinical psychology student at Beheshti University, was arrested after appearing at Yazd Prosecutor's Office. This occurred on Sunday, 15 Shahrivar. No further details are provided in the text.

Abolfazl Shekarchi, senior spokesperson of the Islamic Republic's armed forces, called Persian-language foreign media and their activists "military targets." Mehdi Mahdavi Azad mentioned these statements on the program "Cheshmandaz." He described these individuals as reckless, arrogant, and dangerous.

The altercation involving offensive language by Khodadad Azizi, manager of Tractor team, towards Omid Alishah drew reactions from Mehdi Tartar and Abdollah Veisi. Veisi called the behavior shameful, and Tartar demanded strict action. Both coaches emphasized preserving culture and preventing such incidents from being heard by the youth.

About 26 workers of the Agricultural Jihad Land Affairs in Sistan and Baluchestan expressed dissatisfaction with wage arrears and non-payment of insurance. They demanded attention to their situation. This report was published by Harana News Agency.

Fatemeh Mohajerani announced that the 60-liter gasoline quota will remain at 1500 tomans and the 50-liter gasoline quota at 3000 tomans without change. The gas station card rate will increase to 10,000 tomans from midnight on September 7.

Mohsen Rezaei announced that the Islamic Republic will declare a new restricted zone in the Persian Gulf starting from the US naval blockade line. Any ship entering this zone will be subject to sanctions by the Islamic Republic. Rezaei described the Strait of Hormuz as completely closed and called Donald Trump's statements about its openness a lie.

Contrary to Iran's international commitments under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, several adolescents from Dorud city were sent to the "Rahian-e Noor" camp in war operational areas. This action violates Iran's obligations regarding the non-use of children in military activities. The issue was reported by Harana News Agency.

After 1401, public policies in Iran moved towards easing restrictions. However, in 1404, following military aggression and security concerns, officials shifted towards increased strictness and proactive control of the streets. These security changes were accompanied by statements from Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf and Ali Larijani.

FIFA has confirmed that Gianni Infantino will run for re-election as president in 2027. Infantino had previously avoided answering questions on this matter. UEFA has launched a campaign to remove him from FIFA.

Meir Javdanfar pointed to the worsening economic crisis, inflation, electricity problems, and growing dissatisfaction in Iran. He stated that predicting the fall of the Islamic Republic remains difficult. He also said that Tehran's reduced financial capacity has seriously affected support for proxy forces, especially Hezbollah.

Donald Trump posted an AI-generated image of an attack by American fighter jets on Khark Island on the Truth Social network. He also shared three statistical charts about Iran's economic situation, including currency value, hyperinflation, and oil exports. These images were published on September 6.

Mohsen Rezaee stated that Israel has taken parts of Lebanon but Lebanon will regain strength and inflict hard blows on Israel. He said the Islamic Republic tested a special anti-destroyer missile over a US warship 48 hours ago. Rezaee reserved the right to respond to the US attack on a wedding ceremony in Kohestak.

An audio version of 'Cheshmandaz' has been released, containing a confidential directive from the Islamic Republic to terror networks abroad. The audio file relates to security and terrorism issues. The source of this news is Iran International.

Leila Morvati said the simultaneous naval blockade and economic sanctions have increased pressure on the Islamic Republic. So far, there is no sign of a change in Tehran's strategy and the likelihood of escalating tensions remains high. China is an important buyer of Iranian oil but is unlikely to risk its relations with the US.

Mohsen Rezaei announced that the Islamic Republic intends to declare an area outside the Strait of Hormuz as a forbidden zone. Any ship entering this area with the aim of passing through the strait will be sanctioned. Rezaei said this action could have a greater impact than missile attacks.

In the sixth week of the Premier League, the match between Tractor and Gol Gohar at Sahand Stadium in Tabriz was accompanied by many controversies. Tractor fans chanted slogans against Omid Alishah before the game. This led to a confrontation between Khodadad Azizi and Alishah.

Mohammad Sadegh Azimifar, Deputy Minister of Oil, announced the identification of free fuel station cards. In this plan, individuals are authenticated through bank cards and verification is done without the user noticing. The system checks the individual's previous fuel consumption by receiving their national ID code.

Esmaeil Baqaei stated that the Strait of Hormuz was open before the US and Israeli attacks on Iran on March 1. These attacks disrupted commercial shipping and led to higher energy prices. Tensions in the area have increased recently.

The Israeli Prime Minister announced a reduction in fuel prices to half a shekel per liter. He made this announcement while fuel prices in Iran have increased. Netanyahu thanked the Israeli Finance Minister for cooperating in reducing fuel prices.

Mohammad Qaedi said the plan to create a no-go zone in the Persian Gulf could be a tool to pressure shipping. He added that the US aims to change Iran's behavior by limiting its oil exports. This strategy will continue as long as it is deemed effective.

Dalgha Khatinoglu stated that the increase in gasoline prices generates only about one billion dollars in annual revenue for the government. This amount neither compensates for the losses from oil sanctions nor covers the cost of gasoline imports. She also said that this price increase will not significantly reduce gasoline consumption and will put more pressure on drivers.

An Amazon Prime Air cargo plane ran off the runway while landing at Miami International Airport on Sunday, 15 Shahrivar, causing all runways and flights to be halted. Local officials said at least five people were killed and five others injured. The plane was a Boeing 767 operated by Air 21 for Amazon, and the US Federal Aviation Administration has begun investigating the cause.

Leon Panetta, former US defense secretary, warned that the war with the Islamic Republic may continue for at least six more months and could become a never-ending war. He presented three options for the US and said victory is only possible by changing the approach and focusing on reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Panetta also pointed to chaos in the Pentagon and concerns about war management.

Two forces of the Shahid Mirhosseini operational base were killed in a shooting attack on a support vehicle in Zahedan. The attackers targeted a vehicle carrying equipment and food for local Basij forces. Iranian authorities have called the attack terrorist, but the identity and motive of the attackers remain unknown.

The Hengaw human rights organization reported that six women were executed and at least 20 female activists were arrested in Iran in August 2026. It also recorded the death sentence for one woman and 19 cases of femicide. Most of the killings were related to family disputes.

Mark Levin, an American commentator, has once again called for arming the people of Iran. He previously suggested that the US should train and support the Iranian people. Levin also referred to the Reagan Doctrine and urged the US or Israel to take action in this regard.

Joe Wilson, a Republican member of the US Congress, welcomed the success of Yemen government forces against Houthi attacks. He said the Houthis lost large areas in the clashes and called for an end to the Islamic Republic's influence in Yemen. The fighting in Yemen has intensified in recent days.

Data from Kepler shows that the average daily passage of cargo ships through the Strait of Hormuz has decreased to 10 vessels. This is the lowest level since May and indicates a significant decline in traffic. The new statistics confirm the continuation of the downward trend.

Anita Anand, Canada's Foreign Minister, stated that the threats from the Islamic Republic in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's illegal nuclear activities threaten global peace. She referred to a joint statement with Canada's Finance Minister about sanctions and pressure on Iran. Canada continues to exert pressure on the Islamic Republic in cooperation with its partners.

Mohammad Reza Bahonar stated that negotiations should be conducted from a position of strength and the dignity of the Islamic Republic must be preserved. He emphasized that Iran has never initiated war but has enhanced its defensive capabilities. Any aggression against Iran will be met with a decisive response.

Farzin Nadimi, a senior defense researcher, suggested that the IRGC might establish a no-go zone. He said the IRGC may attack ships inside the Persian Gulf and east of the Strait of Hormuz. These vessels are easier targets for attacks.

Shahram Khaledi stated that Hezbollah is the forefront of the Islamic Republic's proxy program in the region and is on the verge of collapse. He added that Israel's attacks on Hezbollah send a message to Tehran. Benjamin Netanyahu emphasized the destruction of the command and leadership of forces acting against Israel.

Habib Ghasemi stated that the European Union has sided with the US in the economic war and is a legitimate target for Iran. He said the enemy should be punished beyond the regional level and cooperation with Yemeni forces should be used to exert economic pressure on Europe. These remarks were made in an interview with the Khaneh Mellat news agency.

Houshang Hasenyari stated that the attacks by Yemen's government forces on Houthi positions represent an important change in the Yemen war. He added that with support from Saudi Arabia, the US, and possibly Israel, the attacks will continue and the Houthis will be weakened. The approach of government forces to coastal areas and Bab al-Mandab could shift conditions against the Houthis.

Ahmad Farrokhfal, deputy director of religious seminaries, stated in a meeting in Ramsar that the clergy and seminaries stand with the nation until their last drop of blood and will not stop fighting the enemy. He emphasized that Islam is guaranteed through the continuity of leadership, and the enemy targets this leadership. Farrokhfal described the leadership as the key to confronting arrogance and true Muhammadan Islam.
Iranians in Calgary held another protest in front of the city hall. They demanded an end to repression and executions in Iran. They also emphasized solidarity with the people inside the country.

Danial Karimi, the father of Amir Mohammad Karimi who was killed in the December 1404 protests in Marvdasht, committed suicide on September 6. Amir Mohammad Karimi was 19 years old and a former member of Iran's national youth taekwondo team. His body was buried in the village of Joonjan.

Reza Niaparest, a master's student of history at Beheshti University, was sentenced by the disciplinary committee to two semesters of suspension and expulsion for causing unrest and insulting religious or national symbols. The sentence is preliminary. The issue concerns his behavior within the university environment.

Ali Dadpay described the gasoline price increase as late and ill-timed. He said this action transfers costs to the people and does not solve the fuel shortage. He also warned that higher transportation costs could lead to price increases.

Siamak Mofidi, 17, and Soroush Enayati, 16, two teenagers from Takab, were arrested by security forces on Saturday. They were transferred to an unknown location in Tehran. The arrest took place in Takab county.

Amir Hamidi, a national security expert, explained the US Energy Secretary's remarks about economic pressure on the Islamic Republic. The goal of this strategy is to change Tehran's cost-benefit calculation. Limiting Iran's oil exports increases the cost of continued confrontation for the Islamic Republic.

Esmaeil Baghai, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, reacted to reports about the possible deployment of non-combat equipment by South Korea near the Strait of Hormuz. He stated that any military presence or participation in operations in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz by other countries is considered direct support for the perpetrators of aggression. He warned that this action will have serious consequences.

Abdolhossein Khosropanah called for governance changes in Khatam Headquarters and the Armed Forces General Staff. He stated that all institutions should build drones capable of countering the F-35. He also emphasized that Iran will not build nuclear bombs but will target enemy nuclear sites if attacked.

A group of Iranians living in Austin, Texas, participated in the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" on Sunday, 15 Shahrivar. They lit a candle for the immortal names of the national revolution. This event was reported by Iran International.

Saeed Hassani, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Shiraz, remains detained in Adel Abad prison after 77 days. He was recently moved from solitary confinement to the general ward and has met with his family. His legal case is still unresolved, and no trial has been held for him yet.

Rouhollah Rahimpour commented on the Islamic Republic's threat to create a new restricted zone in regional waters, stating that the boundaries and rules are not yet clear. He suggested the goal might be psychological warfare with the US and increasing escort costs for ships. This move could also be an attempt to create a new bargaining chip in negotiations with the US.

The head of the league announced that the Football Federation's board decided that the unfinished league from last year has no champion. This decision was made a few months ago and the league's case is closed. The Esteghlal club had previously stated that it would pursue the championship trophy through legal channels.

An Iranian citizen participated in the night half-marathon in the Praga district of Warsaw on Sunday, September 6, wearing a shirt adorned with the Lion and Sun emblem. He completed the five-kilometer route. These videos were received by Iran International.

Hakan Fidan and Muhammad Ishaq Dar held a phone conversation about regional developments and conflicts in the Strait of Hormuz. They emphasized maintaining maritime security and preventing escalation of tensions. This call followed Fidan's discussion with Abbas Araghchi about negotiations with the United States.

Khabar Varzeshi criticized Khodadad Azizi's behavior in the conflict with Omid Alishah in a harsh note. The note mentioned Azizi's insults and offensive language and recalled his controversial past. It also emphasized that Azizi does not recognize any limits in his language.

Ismail Baghaei, spokesperson for the Islamic Republic's Foreign Ministry, said the agreement between Iran and Oman to determine a safe transit route in the Strait of Hormuz will be registered in the International Maritime Organization in the coming days. He attributed the insecurity of the Strait of Hormuz to US actions and expressed hope that some parties would not obstruct the implementation of the Iran-Oman agreement.
Anwar Gargash, the UAE foreign policy advisor, stated that the country will not allow energy exports to be held hostage. He also mentioned that rebuilding trust with Iran may take decades.

Esmail Baghayi, spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, stated that negotiations with Oman to establish a temporary safe route in the Strait of Hormuz have reached the final stage. He expressed hope that this agreement will soon be registered with the International Maritime Organization. He also called for no third-party interference in the process.

Saleh Hardani, the second captain of Esteghlal, was sidelined by the team's coach due to his behavior and summoned to the club's disciplinary committee. This decision followed a dispute between him and Yaser Asani over free kicks. Some Esteghlal managers are trying to resolve the player's issue.

Telecommunications retirees held protests in Isfahan and Sanandaj. They demanded attention to their livelihood claims and full implementation of the executive regulations. They also called for organizing supplementary insurance and payment of past years' claims.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf responded to the US Secretary of Defense's threat regarding attacks on Iranian oil tankers by warning that American oil and gas companies and their facilities in the region would be targeted. The US Secretary of Defense stated that if Iran attacks American ships, Iranian oil tankers would be destroyed.

The seventh episode of the documentary series "Death of Khamenei" titled "Khamenei and Women, Life, Freedom" will be released. This episode reviews the former Supreme Leader's reactions to the Women, Life, Freedom uprising. It will be aired on Thursday, September 10th at 20:30 Tehran time on Iran International.

A group of motorcycle couriers in Arak went on strike on Monday, 16 Shahrivar, due to low fares and high commissions. The protest took the form of a strike. Videos of the event were sent to Iran International.

Hossein Taeb, head of the Basij Organization, stated that the enemy has not fulfilled its financial and political commitments. He emphasized that the Islamic Republic will decide based on the real actions of the other side. His message is that every commitment must be implemented and the rights of the nation must be ensured.

Esmaeil Kowsari, a member of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, stated that the armed forces have a plan to expel the United States from the West Asia region and are following it precisely. He also said that Iran does not accept any agreement or memorandum with the US and must continue on its path.

The quarterly meeting of the IAEA Board of Governors has started. The agency's director general stated there has been no progress in relations between Tehran and the agency. Germany, France, the UK, and the US are preparing a draft resolution against Tehran.

Asghar Sharafi reacted to Khodadad Azizi's behavior during the Tractor and Gol Gohar match, stating he should be disciplined. He emphasized that Azizi's actions set a bad example for youth, suggesting that swearing leads to fame. At the end of the match, a verbal altercation occurred between Azizi and Omid Alishah, leading to a complaint from Gol Gohar.

On Tuesday, 9 Shahrivar, the home of Parisa Naseri, a Bahá'í citizen living in Qaemshahr, was searched by security forces. The officers confiscated several of her personal belongings, including books, religious images, mobile phones, and a tablet. Parisa Naseri was questioned during the presence of the security forces at her home.

A citizen in a video sent to Iran International protested the increase in gasoline prices and the reduction of its quota. He said officials claim fares will not change, but everything is getting more expensive. The video criticizes the decisions of the Islamic Republic officials.

Morteza Kazemian, a member of Iran International's editorial board, called Mohsen Rezaei's statements about creating a forbidden zone in the Strait of Hormuz a series of inaccurate and concerning claims. He added that the claim of normal Iranian oil sales contradicts existing data on export declines, and talk of replacing sea routes with land routes is unrealistic. Kazemian also warned that threatening US warships could bring heavy costs for the Islamic Republic.
